Walking.about: Moving on your own legs without thinking about each step.

Running.about: Faster, and costs less stamina with each level.

Observation.about: Looking closely shows more about what you see.

Listening.about: Fainter sounds are heard, and their direction is clearer.

Scent Tracking.about: Smell what is near, and what passed by.

Pain Tolerance.about: Pain still arrives, but it shakes your actions less.

Dodging.about: Getting out of the way of an attack.

Adaptable.about: Whatever you practise, you pick up a little sooner.

Night Eyes.about: The dark hides less from you.

Crafting.about: Making one thing out of others.

Inspect.about: The System shows you what a thing is: its name at first, more as the skill grows.

Quantum Immortality.about: When you die, the world steps back a moment and the killing blow misses. You remember dying.

Revive.about: Bring back someone whose death is not yet final. They return hurt; less so as the skill grows.

Second Breath.about: Your own death does not always hold. You get up again, hurt, and then need a long while before it can happen again.

Dungeoneering.about: Knowing how places under the world are put together, and what they hide.

Movement.about: The body learns to keep itself up: with each level more of the balancing happens by itself, falls are broken with the arms, and getting up comes easier.
